refined_question:
Let xi_{j,n} (j = 1, ..., 2^n) denote the Stern-Brocot points at level n, in the indexing used in formula (67), and let ?(x) be Minkowski’s question-mark function. Define R_n by
R_n := sum_{j=1}^{2^n} (xi_{j,n} - j/2^n)^2 - 2^n integral_0^1 (?(x)-x)^2 dx.
Is it true that R_n tends to 0 as n tends to infinity? ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07456?utm_source=openai))

A later paper explicitly identifies the same question and points back to Section 6.3 of arXiv:1202.4539, which lets us pin down the exact target with high confidence; the accessible preview of the original confirms the survey/open-problem nature of the paper.
